reports.title: The Condensed Interim Consolidated Statements of Earnings provide a summary of the Company’s financial performance and net earnings or loss over the reporting periods.

lines: Attributable capital expenditures to the end of the third quarter of 2026 represent 62% of the 2026 capital expenditures guidance midpoint.
•Silver Production (72% of guidance midpoint): The Company produced 3.4 million silver ounces in the quarter, reaching 72% of the 2026 revised guidance midpoint.
•Gold Production (75% of guidance midpoint): The Company produced 29,552 gold ounces in Q3 2026, aligned to the Company’s revised 2026 guidance, despite the labour disruptions at San Dimas.
Santa Elena achieved 79% and 83% of the revised production guidance midpoint for silver and gold, respectively, as of the end of the third quarter.
La Encantada achieved 81% of the revised production guidance midpoint as of the end of the third quarter.
